scientific_integrity: The model, parameter-to-threshold mapping, and no-tie small-coupling equivalence theorem originate in arXiv:2603.29214v1. Generic saddle-node ghost scaling is established earlier; this statement is the explicit one-seed network boundary and prefactor. No independent scientific audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The proof is for one seed on a unit-weight complete graph, homogeneous threshold, k=1, zero bias, and 0<gamma<1/(4n^2). The gamma^(-3/4) clock concerns first crossing of opinion 1/2 at tau=1 with n>=3 fixed. No extension to heterogeneous networks, stochastic data, or uniform-in-n limits is claimed.
title: A sharp complete-network cascade boundary for a nonlinear threshold relaxation
